topic: Open Public Contracting Tender Integrity and Asset Recovery Bill

findings.title: Ramana Dayaram Shetty v. International Airport Authority of India (1979) 3 SCC 489
findings.limitations: Establishes that executive power in granting public contracts must strictly satisfy Article 14 non-arbitrariness and fairness standards.

gaps: Absence of a unified Open Contracting Data Standard law mandating machine-readable public tender telemetry and summary asset forfeiture for substandard public infrastructure.
